name: source-to-e2e
description: Review source evidence, draft and approve stories, derive requirements, plan and design E2E cases, then gate generation.

stages.prompt: Preserve exact source references and draft missing details as questions.
For brownfield, inspect only the selected Git change set and justified dependencies.
Separate functional and technical requirements and retain source and control links.
Plan E2E coverage for approved stories and both requirement classes.
Write business-facing E2E steps and source-backed expected outcomes.
Score each story, requirement, plan item and case independently against cited evidence.
Package approved E2E cases and traceability; do not run target tests.

tool_intents: observe a user-approved local application URL
